notes.title: UNDERGROUND TURTLE RACES IS RELEASED
notes.notes: We're excited to announce that "Underground Turtle Racing" is now available on Steam! Dive into the thrilling world of turtle racing where you can place strategic bets on four unique turtles. Predict their finishing order and race times to win big. With each round offering new challenges, your goal is to reach $1000 without running out of money. Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate turtle betting champion? Head over to Steam now and start racing!

notes.title: Underground Turtle Races is Coming!
notes.notes: We are excited to announce our first game, "Underground Turtle Racing"! Step into a thrilling world where you can place bets on four racing turtles. Predict the finishing order of the turtles and whether they will complete the race in more or less time than expected. Each round, the turtles showcase different performances, so plan your strategy carefully to win big! Your goal is to reach $1000 by smartly managing your bets. But be cautious—if you run out of money, the game is over. Test your luck and prediction skills to become the ultimate turtle betting champion!
